hero.brief: Iran's IRGC says four oil tankers struck naval mines and caught fire in the strait, and its navy attacked a container ship. Tehran orders the artery shut.
hero.headline: HORMUZ ERUPTS: FOUR TANKERS HIT MINES
hero.sources: Daily Summary Of (stories 03, 30); Just Security Early Edition, 24 Nov 2026

panels.brief: US jury convicts Huawei of trade-secret theft and bank fraud on 10 of 12 counts, acquits it of racketeering. Sentencing: Sept 2027.
panels.headline: HUAWEI GUILTY IN US COURT

panels.brief: Kyiv drones hit freighter Sparta II in the Gulf of Finland and a corvette off Libya. Poland accuses Moscow of an airspace violation.
panels.headline: UKRAINE STRIKES RUSSIAN SHIPS
panels.sources: Daily Summary Of (stories 16, 23); The Global Eye, 24 Nov 2026

panels.brief: Overnight Russian attack hits a Zaporizhzhia apartment block: 2 dead, 40 wounded, four of them children, the governor says.
panels.headline: ZAPORIZHZHIA STRIKE KILLS 2

panels.brief: UN's top court rules 9-6 that Myanmar's forces committed genocide against the Rohingya in 2017 - a first for a state.
panels.headline: ICJ: MYANMAR COMMITTED GENOCIDE

panels.brief: Israeli strike kills Hamas internal security chief Naeem Abu Nahel and six others, straining the ceasefire held since Oct 2025.
panels.headline: HAMAS SECURITY CHIEF KILLED
panels.sources: Daily Summary Of (story 10); Just Security; Reuters via The Global Eye

panels.brief: Suspected Houthi drone wounds 11 at Saudi PIF tower in Riyadh. Yemen says Houthis are 60 km from Aden, ready to attack.
panels.headline: DRONE HITS SAUDI PIF TOWER

panels.brief: Gunmen hold 25 in a Cartagena supermarket; a car bomb in Villavicencio injures 23, eve of the FARC deal's 10th year.
panels.headline: HOSTAGES HELD, CAR BOMB INJURES 23

panels.brief: A Turkish Air Force AS-532 helicopter crashes just after takeoff from Eskisehir on a training flight, killing all five crew members.
panels.headline: AIR FORCE HELICOPTER CRASH KILLS 5

panels.brief: Nvidia's board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO. AI shares jump; Wall Street claws back half of last week's losses.
panels.headline: JENSEN HUANG BACK AT NVIDIA
panels.sources: CWEB Daily Headlines, 24 Nov 2026; Daily Summary Of (story 28)

panels.brief: Senegal regained the Africa Cup of Nations title after a sports court appeal - the day's biggest football verdict.
panels.headline: AFCON TITLE RESTORED ON APPEAL

panels.brief: Suspected cooking-gas blast tears through a packed Hanoi hot pot restaurant: at least 6 dead, more than 10 injured.
panels.headline: RESTAURANT BLAST KILLS AT LEAST 6

panels.brief: President Prabowo nominates Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono to succeed VP Gibran, who resigned Nov 12. Assembly votes by Dec 11.
panels.headline: TWO NAMED TO REPLACE VICE PRESIDENT
